**

Pipino’s in Kitzbühel

** **

**Welcome to **Pipino’s** in **Kitzbühel**—where authentic Italian cuisine meets the charm of the **Tirol** Alps! Tucked away in the heart of this picturesque village, our cozy restaurant offers a warm, family-friendly atmosphere with a focus on fresh, high-quality ingredients. Whether you're craving a classic **Spaghetti Bolognese**, a crisp **Caprese Salad**, or a hearty **Lasagne**, every dish is crafted with passion to bring a taste of Italy to the mountains. **

**After a day of skiing, hiking, or exploring the stunning landscapes of **Kitzbühel**, unwind with our delicious **Tiramisu** or a creamy **Panna Cotta**. For those who love a glass of fine wine, our carefully selected Italian vintages pair perfectly with your meal. **

**At **Pipino’s**, we believe in good food, great company, and unforgettable moments. Come and experience the perfect blend of Italian flair and **Tirol** hospitality—just a stone’s throw from the lively **Kitzbühel** village square! **

**We look forward to welcoming you soon! **Mangia bene, rilassati, e goditi la vita!**

**
